pokemon_scp.name: Metapod
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0011 is to be suspended within a soft-impact cradle inside a controlled metamorphosis chamber. Vibrational sensors must remain active at all times. Personnel are prohibited from applying external force to SCP-0011’s shell.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0011 is a chrysalis-stage organism with an exoskeleton of anomalous hardness. Internal scans reveal rapid biological restructuring, though external movement is minimal. The shell can withstand impacts exceeding industrial-grade compression tools.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: SCP-0011 remains largely inert but emits faint internal shifting sounds. Sudden environmental changes cause the shell to tighten, increasing hardness temporarily.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0011-A: A researcher reported rhythmic tapping from within SCP-0011. Audio analysis suggests patterned movement, possibly communicative.
Addendum 0011-B: During a containment accident, SCP-0011 survived a 3-meter fall without structural damage.

pokemon_scp.name: Butterfree
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0012 is to be contained in an aviary dome with pollen filtration systems. Personnel must wear respiratory protection during interaction. All windows must remain sealed to prevent spore drift.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0012 is a winged insectoid organism capable of dispersing psychoactive spores. These spores induce mild euphoria, disorientation, or emotional vulnerability depending on concentration. Wing scales exhibit iridescent patterns that shift unpredictably.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: SCP-0012 is gentle but easily startled. When distressed, it releases a dense cloud of spores and attempts to flee upward.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0012-A: A containment assistant exposed to SCP-0012 spores reported vivid memories of events that never occurred.
Addendum 0012-B: Wing scale samples show fractal patterns that rearrange when observed under UV light.

pokemon_scp.name: Weedle
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0013 is to be kept in a terrarium with toxin-neutralizing substrate. Personnel must avoid direct contact with SCP-0013’s horn. Antivenom kits must be available.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0013 is a small larval organism equipped with a venomous horn capable of delivering neurotoxic stings. Venom samples show rapid degradation outside SCP-0013’s body, complicating analysis.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: SCP-0013 is timid and prefers to burrow. It raises its horn defensively when cornered.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0013-A: SCP-0013’s venom caused temporary paralysis in a researcher despite minimal exposure.
Addendum 0013-B: Burrowing patterns appear to form simple geometric shapes.

pokemon_scp.name: Kakuna
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0014 is to be suspended in a hardened cocoon chamber with toxin filtration. No physical disturbance is permitted. Chamber temperature must remain stable.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0014 is a chrysalis-stage organism with a rigid shell containing potent venom sacs. Internal restructuring is visible through translucent segments, though SCP-0014 remains immobile.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: SCP-0014 occasionally twitches, releasing trace venom droplets from microfractures in its shell.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0014-A: Venom droplets dissolved a steel pin within minutes.
Addendum 0014-B: SCP-0014’s twitching increases during thunderstorms.

pokemon_scp.name: Beedrill
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0015 is to be contained in a reinforced aerial combat chamber with automated tranquilizer turrets. Personnel must not enter without full armor. All ventilation shafts must be sealed.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0015 is an aggressive insectoid organism equipped with dual venomous stingers capable of piercing reinforced steel. Flight speed exceeds 60 km/h in confined spaces. Venom causes rapid necrosis.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Extremely territorial. SCP-0015 coordinates attacks with rapid aerial maneuvers and displays swarm-like behavior even when isolated.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0015-A: SCP-0015 breached containment by drilling through a titanium panel.
Addendum 0015-B: Venom samples show adaptive properties, altering toxicity based on target biology.

pokemon_scp.name: Pidgey
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0016 is to be housed in a small aviary with mild airflow simulation. Interaction permitted with Level 1 clearance.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0016 is a small avian organism capable of generating localized dust clouds to obscure vision. Feathers contain microstructures that trap airborne particles.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Docile and easily trained. Uses dust clouds defensively.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0016-A: SCP-0016 produced a dust cloud that disrupted motion sensors.
Addendum 0016-B: Feather samples show anomalous static charge retention.

pokemon_scp.name: Pidgeotto
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0017 is to be contained in a mid-sized aviary with reinforced glass. Personnel must avoid sudden movements.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0017 displays enhanced aerial speed and precision. Talons can exert force sufficient to fracture bone.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Shows predatory instincts and territorial aggression.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0017-A: SCP-0017 dive‑bombed a drone, destroying it instantly.
Addendum 0017-B: Behavioral patterns suggest strategic hunting tactics.

pokemon_scp.name: Pidgeot
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0018 is to be contained in a large aerial dome with wind‑resistant barriers. No personnel may enter during flight cycles.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0018 can generate sonic‑level wingbeats capable of shattering glass. Flight speed exceeds 100 km/h indoors.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Highly territorial and aggressive toward perceived threats.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0018-A: Sonic wingbeats disabled an entire monitoring array.
Addendum 0018-B: SCP-0018 attempted to escape by exploiting a pressure differential.

pokemon_scp.name: Rattata
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0019 is to be contained in a rodent‑proof enclosure with motion sensors. All wiring must be reinforced.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0019 is a small rodent capable of chewing through metal with anomalous dentition. Displays rapid reproduction under stress.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Highly alert and evasive. Attempts to escape through any opening.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0019-A: SCP-0019 chewed through a steel vent in under 40 minutes.
Addendum 0019-B: Reproduction rate increases when exposed to electromagnetic fields.

pokemon_scp.name: Raticate
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0020 is to be contained in a reinforced chamber with shock‑resistant flooring. Personnel must avoid proximity to SCP-0020’s bite radius.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0020 is a large rodent with powerful incisors capable of severing rebar. Displays heightened aggression and territorial dominance.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Extremely hostile when cornered. Uses rapid lunges to attack.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0020-A: SCP-0020 bit through a containment bar rated for industrial load.
Addendum 0020-B: SCP-0020 appears to recognize weak structural points instinctively.
